subject: VMWARE_ESXI_FROZEN_PROFILE
scope: PCIe Correctable AER external behavior only; no VMware private implementation inference

safetyBoundary.precondition: Endpoint CES and endpoint/root UES, Root Status and Source are W1C-cleared and read back; only the explicitly recorded sticky e1000e Device Status.CED is tolerated
safetyBoundary.stopCondition: Any UES, non-CED Device Status or Root Uncorrectable reception delta yields FAIL_SAFETY and stops remaining injections

runs.coverage: 8 Correctable bits x CERE-blocked, endpoint-masked and routed-with-Root-COR_EN-disabled gates

runs.interpretation: The only failed evidence dimension was an active-user API sample lost to an unrelated stale ManagedObject reference; all AER safety/status checks passed. The raw FAIL is retained and is not promoted to VMware behavior evidence.
Confirms the final runner hash after the stale deleted ManagedObject handling fix; AER allow-list, safety checks and oracle are unchanged.

observedBehavior.statusDeposition: All eight PassthruIdle cases deposited exactly the requested CES bit from a requested-bit-clean baseline; Receiver and Advisory Non-Fatal also projected to the active Guest raw body
observedBehavior.messageRouting: NOT_TESTABLE_ENDPOINT_CERE_DISABLED for every ESXi case; Root reception and a matching Correctable Source were not observed
observedBehavior.guestSurface: AER Extended Capability header remained zero, raw CES changed with the endpoint, _OSC did not grant AER and no Guest AER event line was observed
observedBehavior.boundedHostLogs: No matching event was observed in the captured vmkernel/vobd/syslog tail window; this is not proof that ESXi did not service an event
observedBehavior.owner: PassthruIdle had no powered-on VM users; both Active representative cases retained the same unique VM/device user through injection and released it after the probe powered off
observedBehavior.safety: Endpoint/root/Guest UES remained zero, non-CED Device Status did not appear, Root Uncorrectable reception did not appear and the host stayed responsive

qemuControlBehavior.cereDisabled: CES and CED set; Root Status and Source remain zero
qemuControlBehavior.endpointMasked: CES and CED set; Root Status and Source remain zero
qemuControlBehavior.cereEnabledUnmaskedRootCommandDisabled: CES and CED set; Root COR_RCV records and Correctable Source matches the endpoint requester; disabling Root COR_EN does not suppress Root status recording in this QEMU model

runnerHashes.postRunChange: Only stale deleted ManagedObject handling changed; the allow-list, safety checks and AER oracle are unchanged; the final hash passed a live PassthruIdle Receiver smoke run

claimsExcluded: ERR_COR delivery or ESXi Root service for the frozen CERE-disabled profile
interrupt delivery or host service inferred from log absence
real Bad TLP, Bad DLLP, replay, electrical or link behavior
a real Header Log queue overflow
physical device internal state, reset cleanliness, health, quarantine or safe tenant reuse
other ESXi builds, devices, firmware, machine profiles or Qman product conformance
